title: White Bean and Kale Soup
subtitle: A hearty Tuscan soup of cannellini beans and kale in herbed broth
excerpt: This is ribollita-adjacent: a thick, nourishing Italian soup of white beans and dark greens. It takes 30 minutes and tastes as though it has been simmering for hours.
sourceNotes: Ribollita and acquacotta are Tuscan peasant soups built on beans, greens, and old bread. This version keeps the same principles: cannellini beans, kale, and a generous pour of olive oil at the end.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze for up to 3 months. The kale softens slightly on reheating but the flavour holds well.
recipe.batchNotes: Make a large batch and refrigerate for up to 4 days. It thickens in the fridge; add water when reheating.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Like most bean soups, this tastes better the next day.

content.text: Crushing some of the beans before adding the stock is what gives this soup its thick, creamy consistency without any cream.
Heat the olive oil in the stockpot over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and carrot. Cook for 8 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and rosemary sprigs. Cook for 2 minutes more.
Add half the beans. Using the back of a spoon or a fork, crush them roughly in the pot to thicken the soup base.
Add the remaining whole beans, then pour in the stock. Bring to a simmer.
Add the kale. Simmer for 10 to 12 minutes until the kale is tender. Remove the rosemary sprigs.
Stir in the lemon juice. Season generously. Ladle into bowls, drizzle with extra olive oil, and top with Parmesan if using.

items.symptom: The soup is watery with no body.
items.cause: Not enough beans were crushed to thicken the base.
items.fix: Remove a cup of beans, mash, and stir back in.

items.symptom: The kale is tough and chewy.
items.cause: It was added too late or was not simmered long enough.
items.fix: Continue simmering for another 5 to 10 minutes.

items.symptom: The soup tastes flat despite seasoning.
items.cause: Acid was not added at the end.
items.fix: Add more lemon juice; a small squeeze makes a significant difference.
